title: Making Lodebreaker with Claude — getting the UI and visuals consistent has taken a lot of iteration
author: Boogygames__Studios
selftext:
Hi everyone, I’m the developer behind Dusty Rocket Games. I’ve been using Claude to help build Lodebreaker, and wanted to share a look at the project.

It hasn’t been a case of sending one prompt and getting a finished game. I’ve been working through focused passes for bugs, saving and loading, and the interface instead of trying to change everything at once.

One of the biggest challenges has been getting the icons and UI to look consistent. I’ve gone through several versions that I wasn’t happy with. Getting something working and getting the presentation right are very different things.

Some character, background and icon artwork was also made with AI tools and edited during development.

These screenshots show the actual game. I’d be interested to hear how others keep their AI-assisted artwork and interface consistent across a whole project.



Steam page: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5357630/Lodebreaker/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5357630/Lodebreaker/)
